name: Почувствуй мою боль
overview: Teacher Alyona is fired from school after a conflict with a student- the son of an influential official. She goes to a big city and becomes an assistant to businessman Sergey. A relationship develops between them. Alyona marries him and gives birth to a daughter. But Sergey's ex-lover stands between their happiness, ready to use Alyona and the child to uncover the secrets of the businessman
